# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 29 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** The Oil of Mercy Is Promised for the Future

---

**29:1** Michael said to Seth: 'The oil of mercy will not come to you now. Many generations must pass before the time of the Son of God.'

**29:2** 'When he comes, he will raise up all the righteous and give them the oil of mercy for eternal life.'

**29:3** Seth received these words in his heart and told them to his father Adam.

---
